name: AEAD column-level encryption
description: Protects individual column values with authenticated encryption, using keysets and the AEAD encrypt and decrypt functions, optionally bound to associated data.

name: APPENDS
description: Table function that returns the rows inserted into a table during a given time range, with extra columns for the change type and change timestamp.

name: Authorized views/datasets/routines
description: Lets a view, dataset or routine query tables in another dataset on behalf of users who have no direct access to that source dataset.
notes: Authorized routines are refused: Dataset access routine entries fail with 400, and authorized dataset entries accept only targetTypes VIEWS (ROUTINES is refused).

name: Auto-refresh (configurable interval)
description: Refreshes a materialized view in the background at an interval you set with its refresh options, so its stored results stay current.

name: Batch loading from Cloud Storage
description: Loads data files such as CSV, JSON, Avro, Parquet or ORC from Cloud Storage into a BigQuery table with a load job.

name: BigLake tables (with fine-grained access)
description: Tables over data in Cloud Storage and other stores that are read through a connection and can be secured with row-level and column-level access controls.
notes: fine-grained access is not served on BigLake tables: row access policies over an external table are refused ('Row access policy source must be an ordinary physical table'), and column-level security and data masking on BigLake tables are untested; the connection is a reference only, with no delegated service-account credentials.

name: BigQuery Storage Write API (preferred)
description: The recommended high-throughput API for writing rows to BigQuery tables as streams or batches over gRPC, with exactly-once delivery when stream offsets are used.

name: Cached results
description: Reuses the stored result of an identical earlier query for roughly 24 hours instead of running it again.
notes: No query cache is kept, so a repeated identical query always runs again and reports cacheHit=false; BigQuery may answer it from cached results.

description: The pipe operator, which passes the result of one query step into the next so a query can be written as a left-to-right sequence of operations.

name: CHANGES
description: Table function that returns the rows inserted, updated or deleted in a table during a given time range, with extra columns for the change type and change timestamp.

name: Clustered tables (up to 4 columns)
description: Sorts a table's storage by up to four clustering columns so queries that filter or aggregate on those columns read less data.

name: Column-based partitioning (DATE, TIMESTAMP, DATETIME, INT64 range)
description: Divides a table into partitions by the values of a DATE, TIMESTAMP or DATETIME column, or by ranges of an INT64 column, so queries can read only some partitions.
notes: Partition decorators (table$partition_id) are not accepted by load, copy or query-destination writes, so those writes cannot target or replace a single partition (tabledata.insertAll accepts daily decorators only, as BigQuery does).

name: Column-level security (policy tags)
description: Restricts who can read individual columns by attaching policy tags from a taxonomy, which are then checked against IAM permissions.
notes: Taxonomy import/export and cross-location taxonomy replication are not served; custom masking routines do not apply to leaf fields nested in repeated records, and direct data policies do not attach to repeated fields.

name: CREATE TABLE AS CLONE OF
description: Creates a writable clone of a table or snapshot that shares storage with the original and is billed only for data that differs.

name: Data masking (column masking)
description: Returns obfuscated values, such as a hash, a default value or NULL, for protected columns to readers who only have masked access.

name: Destination table creation
description: Writes query results to a table you name, creating it if needed, instead of to the temporary table BigQuery uses by default.

name: Differential privacy functions
description: Aggregate functions used with differential privacy that add calibrated noise to results so individual rows cannot be inferred.

name: Dry run mode
description: Validates a query and estimates how many bytes it would process without running it or incurring query charges.

name: Export to Bigtable, Spanner, Pub/Sub, AlloyDB
description: Uses EXPORT DATA to send query results to operational destinations such as Bigtable, Spanner, Pub/Sub or AlloyDB rather than to files.
notes: Only Pub/Sub export through continuous queries is served; EXPORT DATA to Bigtable (CLOUD_BIGTABLE), Spanner (CLOUD_SPANNER) and AlloyDB is not implemented.

name: FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF timestamp
description: Reads a table as it existed at a given past timestamp, within the time travel window, by adding a time clause after the table name.

name: Graph pattern matching
description: Finds nodes and edges in a property graph that fit a pattern, using MATCH inside GRAPH_TABLE, and returns their properties as rows.
notes: Quantified (variable-length) path patterns such as -->{1,3} and path search prefixes (ANY, ANY SHORTEST, ALL SHORTEST) are not supported; only fixed-length patterns match.

name: Hive partitioned external tables
description: External tables over Cloud Storage files laid out in Hive-style key=value directories, with the partition keys exposed as queryable columns.

name: Hyperparameter tuning
description: Runs several training trials with different hyperparameter values during CREATE MODEL and keeps the model that scores best on an objective.
notes: edition:Full edition only (the lite edition answers 400 invalidQuery).|external-production-service:VIZIER_DEFAULT, the default tuning algorithm, trains only when a Vizier-compatible optimizer endpoint is configured; without one CREATE MODEL fails.

name: Incremental refresh
description: Updates a materialized view by processing only the base table changes since the last refresh instead of recomputing the whole query.
notes: No materialized data is kept and no incremental refresh runs: refresh only advances lastRefreshTime/refreshWatermark, and max_staleness never returns stale rows.

name: Ingestion-time partitioning (PARTITIONTIME, PARTITIONDATE)
description: Partitions a table by the time rows were loaded and exposes the _PARTITIONTIME and _PARTITIONDATE pseudo-columns for filtering.
notes: Partition decorators (table$YYYYMMDD) are accepted only by tabledata.insertAll, so load, copy and query-destination writes cannot name a partition; DML writes to named partitions through _PARTITIONTIME.

name: insertId
description: An optional per-row identifier sent with streaming inserts that BigQuery uses to drop duplicate rows on a best-effort basis.

name: jobs.insert with copy config
description: Starts a copy job that copies one or more source tables into a destination table, with a write disposition and optional encryption settings.

name: jobs.insert with extract config
description: Starts an extract job that exports table data to Cloud Storage as CSV, JSON, Avro or Parquet files.

name: jobs.insert with query config
description: Starts a query job from SQL text, with options such as destination table, priority, query parameters and write disposition.

name: Lightweight copies, copy-on-write
description: A table clone is a lightweight, writable copy of a table whose storage is shared with the base table until the data diverges.
notes: quota-or-billing:a clone stores a full physical copy of the base table's rows instead of sharing storage until the data diverges, so its storage is not delta-only.

name: Lightweight, copy-on-write
description: A table snapshot is a read-only copy of a table at a point in time that stores only the data that has since changed in the base table.
notes: quota-or-billing:a snapshot stores a full physical copy of its rows instead of sharing unchanged storage with the base table, so its storage is not delta-only.

name: Load jobs via REST API (jobs.insert with load config)
description: Starts a load job whose configuration reads files from Cloud Storage, or uploaded content, into a destination table with a schema and format.

name: Maximum bytes billed
description: A job setting that makes a query fail without charge if it would process more than the stated number of bytes.

name: ML.TRANSFORM
description: Applies the preprocessing defined in a model's TRANSFORM clause to input data and returns the resulting feature columns.
notes: edition:Full edition only (the lite edition answers 400 invalidQuery).|TRANSFORM works for linear/logistic regression, KMEANS, boosted trees, random forests and TRANSFORM_ONLY; * REPLACE, expression.*, named preprocessing arguments and WARM_START are refused.

name: Object tables (for unstructured data)
description: Read-only tables over unstructured objects in Cloud Storage, such as images and documents, where each row describes one object and its metadata.
notes: ObjectRef functions (OBJ.MAKE_REF, OBJ.FETCH_METADATA, OBJ.GET_ACCESS_URL, OBJ.GET_READ_URL) and the EXTERNAL_OBJECT_TRANSFORM table function are missing ('Function not found'), so object contents cannot be read or signed through SQL; source URIs must be gs:// with * wildcards only (no [ ] patterns) and a table lists at most 10,000 objects; metadata caching options are not served.

name: Pseudo-columns: PARTITIONTIME, PARTITIONDATE
description: Hidden columns on ingestion-time partitioned tables that hold the load time or date of each row and can be used in filters.

name: Query historical data (up to 7 days)
description: Reads a table's earlier state from within the time travel window, which covers up to the past seven days.

name: Range partitioning (INT64)
description: Divides a table into partitions by ranges of an INTEGER column, defined by a start value, an end value and an interval.
notes: Partition decorators (table$partition_id) are not accepted by load, copy or query-destination writes, so those writes cannot target or replace a single partition (tabledata.insertAll accepts daily decorators only, as BigQuery does).

name: RESTORE TABLE FROM SNAPSHOT
description: Creates a writable table from a table snapshot, bringing back the table contents as they were when the snapshot was taken.

name: Row-level security (row access policies)
description: Limits which rows of a table each user or group can query by attaching row access policies that carry a filter expression.

name: Schema auto-detection
description: Infers column names and data types from input data rather than requiring an explicit schema.

name: SEARCH()
description: Checks whether a table, row or value contains the given search terms after tokenizing it, and is typically used with search indexes.

name: SESSION_USER()
description: Returns the email address of the user who is running the current query.

name: Supports INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN, aggregation
description: Lets a materialized view definition include joins, such as inner and left outer joins, and aggregation over its base tables.

name: Table snapshots (create/restore)
description: Preserves a table's contents at a point in time as a read-only snapshot and allows that snapshot to be restored into a writable table.

name: Text analyzers (tokenizers)
description: Configurable tokenizers that split text into terms for search indexes and for the SEARCH and TEXT_ANALYZE functions.

name: Time-unit partitioning (daily, hourly, monthly, yearly)
description: Divides a table into partitions by the hour, day, month or year of a DATE, TIMESTAMP or DATETIME column.
notes: Partition decorators (table$partition_id) are not accepted by load, copy or query-destination writes, so those writes cannot target or replace a single partition (tabledata.insertAll accepts daily decorators only, as BigQuery does).

name: VECTOR_SEARCH()
description: Finds the rows in a table that are closest to each query embedding, using a distance metric and optionally a vector index.

name: Write disposition: WRITETRUNCATE, WRITEAPPEND, WRITEEMPTY
description: A load job setting for an existing destination table: WRITE_TRUNCATE replaces its data, WRITE_APPEND adds rows and WRITE_EMPTY fails if it has data.
notes: WRITE_EMPTY into a non-empty destination fails with invalidQuery 'LOAD destination <dataset>.<table> is not empty' rather than BigQuery's duplicate 'Already Exists' error; WRITE_TRUNCATE_DATA is refused.

name: Audit logs
description: Records of administrative actions and data access in BigQuery, written to Cloud Logging for security review and compliance.

name: Authorized datasets
description: Authorizes every view in one dataset to read the tables of another dataset, without granting those views' users access to the source dataset.

name: Authorized views
description: A view that has been granted access to a source dataset, so users can query the view without having access to its underlying tables.

name: Change Data Capture (CDC)
description: Captures row-level inserts, updates and deletes from a source and applies them to a BigQuery table so the table mirrors its source.

name: Column DEFAULT values
description: Lets a column declare a default expression that is used when an inserted row leaves that column out.
notes: A default expression outside the documented forms (for example UPPER('a')) is accepted by CREATE TABLE and tables.insert and refused only when a write uses it, where BigQuery rejects it when the column is defined.

name: Column-level security
description: Controls which users can read sensitive columns by classifying them with policy tags and checking IAM access on each tag.
notes: Taxonomy import/export and cross-location taxonomy replication are not served; custom masking routines do not apply to leaf fields nested in repeated records, and direct data policies do not attach to repeated fields.

name: Connection API (EXTERNAL CONNECTION)
description: Manages connection resources that store the settings and credentials BigQuery needs to reach external sources such as Cloud SQL, Spanner or Cloud Storage.
notes: Served over REST only (the API's gRPC transport is not served); AWS, Azure, Spark and Salesforce Data Cloud connections are stored resources without local execution; Cloud SQL connections reach an instance only through an explicit BIGQUERY_EMULATOR_CLOUD_SQL_INSTANCE_ENDPOINTS mapping; connection IAM policies are unconditional version 1.

name: CREATE MODEL
description: Creates and trains a BigQuery ML model in a dataset from SQL, using a chosen model type, a set of options and a training query.
notes: edition:Full edition only (the lite edition answers 400 invalidQuery).|STRUCT and non-numeric ARRAY features, TRANSFORM for PCA/DNN/autoencoder/time-series/matrix-factorization/contribution models, DNN_LINEAR_COMBINED_*, and TensorFlow/AutoML model types are refused locally.

name: Data Clean Rooms
description: Secure environments where several parties analyze combined data under agreed rules without being able to see each other's raw data.

name: Data masking
description: Hides sensitive column values at query time by applying masking rules tied to policy tags, based on the roles the reader holds.

name: IAM / getIamPolicy
description: Returns the IAM policy attached to a BigQuery resource such as a table or view, listing which principals hold which roles.

name: IAM / setIamPolicy
description: Replaces the IAM policy on a BigQuery resource such as a table or view, which grants or revokes roles for principals.

name: IAM / testIamPermissions
description: Returns which of a list of permissions the caller holds on a BigQuery resource such as a table or view.

name: ML.EVALUATE
description: Computes evaluation metrics, such as precision, recall or mean error, for a trained model against supplied data.

name: ML.GENERATE_EMBEDDING
description: Generates embeddings, which are numeric vector representations of the input, from text or other data using a remote model.

name: ML.GENERATE_TEXT
description: Sends a prompt built from each table row to a remote generative AI model and returns the generated text for that row.

name: ML.PREDICT
description: Runs a trained model over input rows and returns a prediction for each row.

name: ML.WEIGHTS
description: Returns the learned weights of a trained model, such as the feature coefficients of a regression model.

name: Multi-statement transactions
description: Groups several statements between BEGIN TRANSACTION and COMMIT TRANSACTION so that their changes succeed or are rolled back together.
notes: After a statement fails at run time inside a transaction, COMMIT TRANSACTION is refused and statements that read or write tables are refused until ROLLBACK, so a handler cannot commit the earlier changes; CALL and EXECUTE IMMEDIATE inside a transaction are refused; transaction statements inside stored procedure bodies are refused.

name: Parameterized types (NUMERIC(P S))
description: Lets a STRING, BYTES, NUMERIC or BIGNUMERIC column declare a maximum length, or a precision and scale such as NUMERIC(10, 2).
notes: DDL refuses parameterized types inside ARRAY or STRUCT column types ('Parameterized types inside ARRAY or STRUCT column schemas') and refuses repeated NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC columns such as ARRAY<NUMERIC>, which BigQuery accepts; such schemas can only be declared through tables.insert.

name: Remote functions
description: User-defined functions backed by a Cloud Run function or service that SQL queries call over a connection to run custom code.

name: Reservations / Slots
description: Lets you buy dedicated compute capacity measured in slots and assign it to projects through reservations, rather than paying on demand.

name: Row-level security
description: Filters which rows each user or group can see in a table, using row access policies defined on that table.

name: Scheduled queries
description: Runs a SQL query repeatedly on a schedule through the Data Transfer Service, optionally writing the results to a table.

name: Search indexes (CREATE SEARCH INDEX)
description: Creates an index over the text in table columns so SEARCH queries can find terms without scanning the whole table.

name: Session variables (@@)
description: System variables written with a leading @@ that read or set properties of the current session, such as the time zone or query label.
notes: Only @@project_id, @@row_count, @@error.message and @@error.statement_text are readable; other system variables such as @@time_zone, @@dataset_id, @@dataset_project_id, @@current_job_id, @@last_job_id, @@script.*, @@session_id and @@query_label are not available; assigning any system variable with SET is refused; system variables are declared to the analyzer only for multi-statement scripts, so a single-statement query that reads @@project_id is not served.

name: Stackdriver integration
description: Sends BigQuery metrics to Cloud Monitoring and logs to Cloud Logging so they can be charted and used for alerts.

name: Table clones
description: A table clone is a writable copy of a table that shares storage with the base table and is charged only for data that differs.

name: Table snapshots (full)
description: A table snapshot preserves the contents of a table at a point in time as a read-only copy, billed only for data that differs from the base.

name: TEMP tables
description: Temporary tables created with CREATE TEMP TABLE that last for the duration of a script or session and are then deleted automatically.

name: Time travel (FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF)
description: Lets a query read a table as of an earlier timestamp within the time travel window by using the FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF clause.

name: Vector indexes (CREATE VECTOR INDEX)
description: Creates an index on an embedding column to speed up approximate nearest-neighbor lookups made with VECTOR_SEARCH.

name: ASSIGNMENTS
description: Lists the reservation assignments, which connect a project, folder or organization to a reservation, that are defined in an administration project.

name: ASSIGNMENTS_BY_PROJECT
description: Lists the reservation assignments that apply to a single project, showing the reservation and job type each assignment covers.

name: BI_CAPACITIES
description: Shows the BI Engine capacity configured for a project, including its size and any preferred tables.

name: CAPACITY_COMMITMENT_CHANGES
description: Lists the history of changes to capacity commitments, such as creation, renewal and edits, with the time of each change.

name: CAPACITY_COMMITMENTS_BY_PROJECT
description: Lists the slot capacity commitments purchased in a project, with each commitment's plan, slot count and state.

name: COLUMN_FIELD_PATHS
description: Lists every field nested inside STRUCT (RECORD) columns of the tables in a dataset, with its full field path, data type and description.

name: COLUMNS
description: Lists the columns of the tables and views in a dataset, with name, position, data type, nullability and partitioning or clustering details.
notes: A dataset or region that holds an external table (or a table with no canonical local schema) refuses the whole view instead of listing its columns.

name: CONSTRAINT_COLUMN_USAGE
description: Lists the columns that are referenced by primary key and foreign key constraints on the tables in a dataset.

name: EFFECTIVE_PROJECT_OPTIONS
description: Lists the configuration options in effect for a project, whether they were set on the project itself or inherited from its organization.

name: JOBS_BY_PROJECT
description: Lists the jobs submitted in the current project, with job type, state, bytes processed, slot usage and the user who ran each job.

name: JOBS_BY_USER
description: Lists the jobs that the current user submitted in the current project, with their type, state, bytes processed and timing.

name: JOBS_TIMELINE
description: Shows job resource use, such as slot consumption, broken into time slices for jobs in the current project.

name: JOBS_TIMELINE_BY_PROJECT
description: Shows job resource use, such as slot consumption, broken into time slices for jobs in one project.

name: KEY_COLUMN_USAGE
description: Lists the columns that are constrained as primary or foreign keys in a dataset, with their position within each key.

name: MATERIALIZED_VIEWS
description: Lists the materialized views in a dataset, with their defining query, refresh settings and last refresh details.

name: OBJECT_PRIVILEGES
description: Lists the access grants on BigQuery resources, showing which principal holds which role on a dataset or table.

name: PARTITIONS
description: Lists the partitions of the tables in a dataset, with each partition's row count, storage size and last modification time.
notes: last_modified_time is refused for a dataset holding an ingestion-time partitioned table or a table whose retained change history does not cover every row, and storage_tier is refused in that case for tables older than 90 days; total_billable_bytes is refused when the dataset uses PHYSICAL storage billing; __UNPARTITIONED__ is never split into ACTIVE and LONG_TERM rows; a table without local storage refuses the whole view.

name: RESERVATION_CHANGES
description: Lists the history of changes to reservations, such as creating, resizing or deleting one, with the time of each change.

name: RESERVATIONS
description: Lists the current reservations in an administration project, which are pools of slots, with their capacity and edition.

name: RESERVATIONS_BY_PROJECT
description: Lists the current reservations that belong to a project, which are pools of slots, with their capacity and edition.

name: ROUTINE_OPTIONS
description: Lists the options set on the routines in a dataset, such as a routine's description or the libraries it imports.

name: ROUTINES
description: Lists the functions and stored procedures in a dataset, with each routine's type, language, body and return type.

name: SCHEMATA
description: Lists the datasets in a project, with each dataset's location and creation and modification times.

name: SCHEMATA_OPTIONS
description: Lists the options set on each dataset, such as its default table expiration, description and labels.

name: SEARCH_INDEX_COLUMNS
description: Lists the columns covered by search indexes in a dataset, with the name of the indexed column and its table.

name: SEARCH_INDEXES
description: Lists the search indexes in a dataset, with each index's status, creation time, coverage and storage size.

name: SESSIONS_BY_PROJECT
description: Lists every session in the current project, with each session's identifier, owner email and creation and expiration times.

name: SESSIONS_BY_USER
description: Lists the sessions created by the current user, with each session's identifier and creation time.

name: STREAMING_TIMELINE
description: Reports streaming ingestion activity per minute for tables, such as request and row counts and any error codes.

name: STREAMING_TIMELINE_BY_PROJECT
description: Reports streaming ingestion activity per minute for tables in a project, such as request and row counts and any error codes.

name: TABLE_CONSTRAINTS
description: Lists the primary key and foreign key constraints defined on the tables in a dataset.

name: TABLE_OPTIONS
description: Lists the options set on the tables and views in a dataset as name and value pairs, such as expiration, description and labels.
notes: A dataset or region holding an external table refuses the whole view; external-table source options (format, uris and similar) are never listed.

name: TABLE_SNAPSHOTS
description: Lists the table snapshots in a dataset, with the base table each one was taken from and the time it was captured.

name: TABLE_STORAGE
description: Reports current storage use of tables and materialized views in a project, including live, long-term and time travel bytes.

name: TABLES
description: Lists the tables and views in a dataset, with each one's type, creation time and DDL statement.
notes: The ddl column is refused (the query fails) for a dataset or region holding an external table, because external-table DDL is not generated.

name: VECTOR_INDEX_COLUMNS
description: Lists the columns that each vector index in a dataset covers, with the indexed column and its table.

name: VECTOR_INDEXES
description: Lists the vector indexes in a dataset, with each index's status, creation time and how much of the table it covers.

name: VIEWS
description: Lists the views in a dataset, with each view's name and its defining SQL query.

name: NULLABLE
description: The default column mode, which allows NULL values in the field.

name: RECORD (schema API)
description: A column type in the table schema API that holds nested fields, equivalent to STRUCT in SQL.

name: REPEATED
description: A column mode in which the field holds an array of zero or more values of its type.

name: REQUIRED
description: A column mode that requires every row to have a non-NULL value for the field.

name: datasets.delete
description: Deletes a dataset by its ID; the dataset must be empty unless the request asks to delete its contents as well.

name: datasets.get
description: Returns a dataset's metadata, including its location, labels, default expiration settings and access controls.

name: datasets.insert
description: Creates a new, empty dataset in a project, with its location, labels and access controls.
notes: isCaseInsensitive, defaultRoundingMode, externalDatasetReference and linkedDatasetSource are ignored rather than stored.

name: datasets.list
description: Lists the datasets in a project that the caller has read access to, optionally filtered by label.
notes: maxResults and pageToken are ignored, so every dataset comes back in one page with no nextPageToken; the label filter parameter is ignored.

name: datasets.patch
description: Updates only the dataset fields supplied in the request and leaves the other fields unchanged.
notes: isCaseInsensitive and defaultRoundingMode are ignored; If-Match etag preconditions are not checked.

name: datasets.update
description: Replaces the entire dataset resource with the one supplied in the request.
notes: PUT has patch semantics: fields omitted from the body keep their stored values instead of being cleared; isCaseInsensitive and defaultRoundingMode are ignored; If-Match etag preconditions are not checked.

name: jobs.cancel
description: Requests that a running job be cancelled; the call returns at once and the caller polls the job to see whether cancellation completed.

name: jobs.get
description: Returns information about one job, including its configuration, current status and statistics.

name: jobs.getQueryResults
description: Returns the results of a query job one page at a time, optionally waiting for the job to finish.
notes: timeoutMs is ignored, so the call never waits for a running job; a malformed pageToken is ignored rather than refused.

name: jobs.insert
description: Starts a new asynchronous job of one of four kinds: query, load, copy or extract.
notes: Legacy SQL is refused and a query that omits useLegacySql runs as GoogleSQL, where the REST API defaults to legacy SQL; cross-project defaultDataset is refused and cross-project destinationTable is refused; load jobs refuse options outside the implemented set (for example rangePartitioning, destinationEncryptionConfiguration, referenceFileSchemaUri) and copy jobs refuse destinationEncryptionConfiguration; the job runs before the call returns, so the response already reports state DONE.

name: jobs.list
description: Lists the jobs started in a project, most recent first, with their state and basic information.
notes: Projection is ignored, so every listed job carries its full configuration; minCreationTime and maxCreationTime are ignored; only one stateFilter value is applied; a malformed pageToken restarts at the first page instead of being refused.

name: jobs.query
description: Runs a SQL query synchronously and returns the results directly if it finishes within the timeout, or a job reference otherwise.
notes: Legacy SQL is refused and a query that omits useLegacySql runs as GoogleSQL, where the REST API defaults to legacy SQL; cross-project defaultDataset is refused; preserveNulls, destinationEncryptionConfiguration and other QueryRequest fields outside the admitted set are refused; timeoutMs is validated but the call always waits for the query, so jobComplete=false is never returned; jobTimeoutMs, maxSlots and reservation are recorded but not enforced.

name: models.delete
description: Deletes the BigQuery ML model identified by its ID from a dataset.

name: models.get
description: Returns the metadata of one BigQuery ML model, such as its type, training runs and feature columns.

name: models.list
description: Lists the BigQuery ML models in a dataset, which the caller must have read access to, with their IDs and types.

name: models.patch
description: Updates only the model fields supplied in the request, such as its description, labels or expiration time.

name: projects.getServiceAccount
description: Returns the email address of the service account that BigQuery uses for a project when it works with Cloud KMS keys.
notes: The email is bq-emulator@{projectId}.iam.gserviceaccount.com instead of the production encryption service account bq-{projectNumber}@bigquery-encryption.iam.gserviceaccount.com|managed-identity:no Google-managed service account stands behind the address, so it cannot be granted access to a Cloud KMS key.

name: projects.list
description: Lists the projects the caller has been granted access to, with their IDs and friendly names.
notes: maxResults and pageToken are ignored and no nextPageToken is returned; numericId is published as a JSON number rather than a uint64 string|managed-authorization:every known project is listed whatever roles the caller holds on it.

name: routines.delete
description: Deletes a routine, which is a function or stored procedure, by its ID from a dataset.
notes: managed-authorization:routines calls check no bigquery.routines.* permission, and the routines API answers notImplemented when IAM is delegated to an external policy endpoint.

name: routines.get
description: Returns a routine's definition, including its arguments, return type, language and body.
notes: managed-authorization:routines calls check no bigquery.routines.* permission, and the routines API answers notImplemented when IAM is delegated to an external policy endpoint.

name: routines.insert
description: Creates a new routine, either a function or a stored procedure, in a dataset.
notes: edition:JavaScript routines: full edition only (the lite edition answers 400 invalidQuery); SQL routines, procedures and table functions work in both editions.|languages other than SQL and JavaScript (for example PYTHON) are refused; JavaScript routines with importedLibraries are refused|managed-authorization:routines calls check no bigquery.routines.* permission, and the routines API answers notImplemented when IAM is delegated to an external policy endpoint.

name: routines.list
description: Lists the routines, which are functions and stored procedures, in a dataset that the caller has read access to.
notes: readMask accepts only routineReference, routineType, language, creationTime, lastModifiedTime, etag, arguments, returnType, returnTableType, definitionBody, description and *; other masks are refused|managed-authorization:routines calls check no bigquery.routines.* permission, and the routines API answers notImplemented when IAM is delegated to an external policy endpoint.

name: routines.update
description: Replaces the entire routine resource with the definition supplied in the request.
notes: edition:JavaScript routines: full edition only (the lite edition answers 400 invalidQuery); SQL routines, procedures and table functions work in both editions.|languages other than SQL and JavaScript (for example PYTHON) are refused; JavaScript routines with importedLibraries are refused|managed-authorization:routines calls check no bigquery.routines.* permission, and the routines API answers notImplemented when IAM is delegated to an external policy endpoint.

name: bigquery.rowAccessPolicies.delete
description: Deletes a row access policy from a table, which removes its row filter for the principals it covered.
notes: The force parameter is ignored: deleting the table's last policy succeeds without force=true, which widens access where production requires force.

name: bigquery.rowAccessPolicies.get
description: Returns the definition of one row access policy, including its filter expression and the principals it applies to.

name: bigquery.rowAccessPolicies.update
description: Replaces the definition of an existing row access policy, such as its filter expression or the principals it applies to.
notes: A body that omits filterPredicate or grantees keeps the stored values instead of being refused, although filterPredicate is required.

name: rowAccessPolicies.getIamPolicy
description: Returns the IAM policy attached to a row access policy, showing which principals hold which roles on it.

name: rowAccessPolicies.list
description: Lists all the row access policies defined on a table.

name: rowAccessPolicies.testIamPermissions
description: Returns which of a list of permissions the caller holds on a row access policy.

name: tabledata.insertAll
description: Streams one or more rows into a table without a load job, with optional per-row insert IDs for best-effort de-duplication.

name: tabledata.list
description: Reads rows from a table one page at a time, optionally starting at a row offset and selecting some of the fields.
notes: A malformed pageToken silently restarts at the first row instead of being refused; the pageToken is only a row offset over an unordered scan, so rows written between pages shift page boundaries.

name: tables.delete
description: Deletes a table, along with any data it holds, from a dataset.

name: tables.get
description: Returns a table's metadata, such as its schema, size, partitioning and expiration, but not the rows themselves.
notes: The selectedFields and view (TableMetadataView) parameters are ignored, so the full resource is always returned.

name: tables.getIamPolicy
description: Returns the IAM policy attached to a table or view, listing which principals hold which roles.

name: tables.insert
description: Creates a new, empty table in a dataset, with its schema, partitioning and clustering settings.
notes: tableConstraints (primary and foreign keys) and biglakeConfiguration in the request body are ignored; keys can be declared only through DDL.

name: tables.list
description: Lists the tables and views in a dataset that the caller has read access to, with each one's ID and type.
notes: List entries omit timePartitioning, rangePartitioning, clustering and expirationTime, which production tables.list returns for each table.

name: tables.patch
description: Updates only the table fields supplied in the request, such as its description, schema additions or expiration time.
notes: Relaxing a column from REQUIRED to NULLABLE is refused (schema updates may only append fields); the autodetect_schema parameter is ignored; If-Match etag preconditions are not checked.

name: tables.setIamPolicy
description: Replaces the IAM policy on a table or view, which grants or revokes roles for principals.

name: tables.testIamPermissions
description: Returns which of a list of permissions the caller holds on a table or view.

name: tables.update
description: Replaces the entire table resource with the one supplied in the request.
notes: PUT has patch semantics: fields omitted from the body keep their stored values instead of being replaced; relaxing REQUIRED to NULLABLE is refused; If-Match etag preconditions are not checked.

name: upload.multipart
description: Uploads a file together with its metadata in a single multipart request, which suits small files loaded directly into a table.
notes: A load configuration without sourceFormat is read as NEWLINE_DELIMITED_JSON, where production defaults to CSV; the load runs before the call returns.

name: upload.resumable (content)
description: Sends the file content in one or more requests to the session address of a resumable upload so an interrupted upload can continue.
notes: A load configuration without sourceFormat is read as NEWLINE_DELIMITED_JSON, where production defaults to CSV; upload sessions are held in memory and are lost when the emulator restarts.

name: upload.resumable (init)
description: Starts a resumable upload by sending the job metadata, and returns the session address to which the file content is then sent.
notes: A load configuration without sourceFormat is read as NEWLINE_DELIMITED_JSON, where production defaults to CSV; upload sessions are held in memory and are lost when the emulator restarts.

name: Non-recursive CTEs
description: A common table expression defined by a name and a query in a WITH clause that does not refer to itself; the main query uses it like a temporary table.

name: WITH cte AS (...)
description: Defines one named common table expression in a WITH clause so the query that follows can read its result by that name.

name: WITH cte1 AS (...), cte2 AS (...)
description: Defines several comma-separated common table expressions in one WITH clause; each can use the ones declared before it, and the main query can use all of them.

name: WITH RECURSIVE
description: Adds the RECURSIVE keyword to a WITH clause so a CTE can refer to itself, repeating its recursive step on the previous rows until no new rows are produced.

name: GROUP BY
description: Groups rows that share the same values in the listed columns or expressions into one output row per group, so aggregate functions can summarize each group.

name: GROUP BY CUBE
description: Produces aggregated rows for every combination of the listed grouping columns, including each subset and the grand total, which suits cross-tabulation reports.
notes: grouping-set keys are limited to INT64, STRING, BOOL, BYTES and DATE (FLOAT64, NUMERIC, TIMESTAMP and other key types are refused); a computed key that can raise an error (k + 1) is refused.

name: GROUP BY GROUPING SETS
description: Computes aggregates for each explicitly listed set of grouping columns in a single query, instead of combining several GROUP BY queries with UNION.
notes: grouping-set keys are limited to INT64, STRING, BOOL, BYTES and DATE (FLOAT64, NUMERIC, TIMESTAMP and other key types are refused); a computed key that can raise an error (k + 1) is refused.

name: GROUP BY ROLLUP
description: Produces aggregated rows for each leading prefix of the listed grouping columns, from the most detailed level up to a grand total, giving subtotals along a hierarchy.
notes: grouping-set keys are limited to INT64, STRING, BOOL, BYTES and DATE (FLOAT64, NUMERIC, TIMESTAMP and other key types are refused); a computed key that can raise an error (k + 1) is refused.

name: HAVING
description: Filters groups after GROUP BY or aggregation, keeping only groups whose condition is TRUE; the condition can use aggregate functions and SELECT aliases.

name: IGNORE NULLS (aggregate)
description: Modifier inside an aggregate function call that leaves NULL values out of the function's input, for example ARRAY_AGG(x IGNORE NULLS).
notes: APPROX_QUANTILES(... IGNORE NULLS) is refused ("Function metadata or NULL modifiers unsupported"); among aggregates only ARRAY_AGG accepts an explicit modifier.

name: LIMIT / OFFSET
description: LIMIT caps how many rows a query returns and OFFSET skips a number of rows first; which rows come back is only predictable when an ORDER BY is applied.

name: NULLS FIRST / NULLS LAST
description: Sort modifiers that place NULL values before or after all other values in an ORDER BY, overriding the default where NULL counts as the smallest value.

name: ORDER BY
description: Sorts result rows by one or more expressions, each ascending or descending; in a graph query the ORDER BY statement only takes effect when immediately followed by LIMIT or OFFSET.

name: RESPECT NULLS
description: Modifier on a function call that lets NULL values take part in the function's input and result instead of being skipped.
notes: APPROX_QUANTILES(... RESPECT NULLS) is refused ("Function metadata or NULL modifiers unsupported").

name: WHERE
description: Filters the rows produced by FROM, keeping only rows where the condition is TRUE and discarding rows where it is FALSE or NULL.

name: GRANT
description: Gives one or more IAM roles on a dataset (schema), table, view, external table or project to a list of users, groups or other principals.

name: REVOKE
description: Removes previously granted IAM roles on a dataset, table, view, external table or project from a list of users, groups or other principals.

name: user_list
description: The comma-separated principals that GRANT gives roles to or REVOKE takes them from, each written with a prefix such as user, group, serviceAccount or domain.

name: ACTIVATION_FN
description: Chooses the activation function used by the layers of a neural network model, for example RELU, SIGMOID or TANH.

name: add_replica_options_list
description: Settings for a new dataset replica: the location to create it in and the Cloud KMS key that replaces source-region keys in the destination region.

name: ADJUST_STEP_CHANGES
description: Turns on or off automatic detection and adjustment of step changes in the data while an ARIMA_PLUS time series model is trained.

name: ALTER BI_CAPACITY SET OPTIONS
description: Changes the BI Engine capacity for a project and location, such as its size in gigabytes and the preferred tables to accelerate.

name: alter_capacity_commitment_option_list
description: Settings that can be changed on an existing capacity commitment: its commitment plan and the renewal plan it converts to afterwards.

name: ALTER CAPACITY SET OPTIONS
description: Changes an existing capacity commitment, for example by switching its commitment plan or its renewal plan.

name: ALTER COLUMN DROP DEFAULT
description: Removes the default value from a table column, which has the same effect as setting the default to NULL.

name: ALTER COLUMN DROP NOT NULL
description: Removes the NOT NULL constraint from a table column so that the column can hold NULL values.

name: ALTER COLUMN SET DATA TYPE
description: Changes a column to a less restrictive data type, for example NUMERIC to BIGNUMERIC, but not the other way round.

name: ALTER COLUMN SET DEFAULT
description: Sets the default value of a table column; it applies to rows inserted afterwards that give no value for that column.

name: ALTER COLUMN SET OPTIONS
description: Sets column options, such as the description or the rounding mode, on a top-level column of a table or view.

name: alter_connection_option_list
description: Settings that can be changed on an existing connection: its friendly name and its description.

name: ALTER CONNECTION SET OPTIONS
description: Modifies an existing connection resource by updating its friendly name or its description.

name: ALTER DATA_POLICY
description: Updates an existing data policy, for example by changing its policy type or its masking expression.

name: ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW SET OPTIONS
description: Changes settings of an existing materialized view, such as whether refresh is enabled, the refresh interval, labels and the expiration time.

name: ALTER MODEL
description: Updates settings of an existing BigQuery ML model, such as its description, labels, expiration time and encryption key.

name: alter_option_list
description: Options that can be updated on a data policy: the data policy type and the masking expression.

name: ALTER ORGANIZATION SET OPTIONS
description: Sets organization-level BigQuery defaults, such as the default encryption key, time zone, query job timeout and location.

name: ALTER PROJECT SET OPTIONS
description: Sets project-level BigQuery defaults, such as the default encryption key, time zone, query job timeout, SQL dialect and location.

name: alter_reservation_option_list
description: Settings that can be changed on an existing reservation, such as slot capacity, idle slot use, autoscaling limit, job concurrency and labels.

name: ALTER RESERVATION SET OPTIONS
description: Changes an existing slot reservation, for example its slot capacity, autoscaling limit or whether it ignores idle slots.

name: ALTER SCHEMA ADD REPLICA
description: Adds a replica of a dataset in another location so that the dataset is copied there.

name: ALTER SCHEMA DROP REPLICA
description: Removes a dataset replica that was previously added in a given location.

name: ALTER SCHEMA SET DEFAULT COLLATE
description: Sets the default collation for tables created later in a dataset; existing tables and columns keep the collation they already have.

name: ALTER SCHEMA SET OPTIONS
description: Changes dataset settings such as the default encryption key, default table expiration, description, labels and storage billing model.

name: ALTER SEARCH INDEX
description: Changes an existing search index on a table by setting options, adding, dropping or altering indexed columns, or rebuilding the index.

name: ALTER TABLE
description: Modifies an existing table, for example by setting options, adding or dropping columns, renaming it or changing its constraints.
notes: ADD COLUMN of nested or repeated JSON/GEOGRAPHY, repeated NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC, INTERVAL or parameterized types inside ARRAY/STRUCT is refused; RENAME COLUMN, SET OPTIONS and ALTER COLUMN cannot be combined with other actions in one statement.

name: ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN
description: Adds one or more new columns to an existing table schema; existing rows get NULL, or an empty array for repeated columns, in the new column.

name: ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN, DROP COLUMN
description: Covers the ALTER TABLE forms that add new columns to a table schema and remove existing columns from it.
notes: ADD COLUMN of nested or repeated JSON/GEOGRAPHY, repeated NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC, INTERVAL or parameterized types inside ARRAY/STRUCT is refused.

name: ALTER TABLE ADD FOREIGN KEY
description: Adds an unenforced foreign key constraint to an existing table, linking its columns to the primary key of a referenced table.

name: ALTER TABLE ADD PRIMARY KEY
description: Adds an unenforced primary key on one or more columns of an existing table.

name: ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN
description: Removes one or more columns from a table schema; this only changes metadata and does not immediately free the storage the column used.

name: ALTER TABLE DROP CONSTRAINT
description: Removes a named constraint, such as a foreign key, from an existing table.

name: ALTER TABLE DROP PRIMARY KEY
description: Removes the primary key constraint from an existing table, and with IF EXISTS does nothing when the table has none.

name: ALTER TABLE RENAME COLUMN
description: Renames one or more columns in an existing table schema; primary key columns cannot be renamed.

name: ALTER TABLE RENAME TO
description: Renames a table, a table clone or a table snapshot to a new name.

name: ALTER TABLE SET DEFAULT COLLATE
description: Sets the default collation specification of a table, which new STRING columns inherit when they have no collation of their own.

name: ALTER TABLE SET OPTIONS
description: Changes table settings such as expiration time, description, labels, friendly name, partition expiration and the partition filter requirement.

name: ALTER VECTOR INDEX REBUILD
description: Rebuilds an existing vector index on a table without dropping it, training a replacement index in the background.

name: ALTER VIEW SET OPTIONS
description: Changes view settings such as the expiration time, friendly name, description and labels.

name: APPROX_GLOBAL_FEATURE_CONTRIB
description: Turns on a fast approximation of feature contributions for boosted tree models; it works together with global explanations.

name: AS
description: Introduces the query that supplies the content of the object being created, such as the training data of a model or the rows of a view or table.

name: assignment_option_list
description: Settings of a reservation assignment: the assignee (project, folder or organization), the job type, and per-project scheduling limits.

name: AUTO_ARIMA
description: Controls whether ARIMA_PLUS training automatically searches for the best non-seasonal order; when off, NON_SEASONAL_ORDER must be given.

name: AUTO_ARIMA_MAX_ORDER
description: Sets the largest allowed sum of the non-seasonal p and q terms, which bounds the parameter search space of the auto.ARIMA algorithm.

name: AUTO_ARIMA_MIN_ORDER
description: Sets the smallest allowed sum of the non-seasonal p and q terms in the auto.ARIMA search; a value of 1 or more can rule out flat forecasts.

name: AUTO_CLASS_WEIGHTS
description: Balances class labels in logistic regression training by weighting each class in inverse proportion to how often it occurs.

name: Auto-refresh capability
description: Lets BigQuery refresh a materialized view automatically in the background as its base tables change, with no manual refresh needed.

name: BATCH_SIZE
description: Sets the mini-batch size, the number of samples fed to the neural network at a time, when training a DNN model.

name: bi_capacity_options_list
description: Settings for BI Engine capacity: its size in gigabytes and the list of tables that acceleration should be applied to.

name: BigLake external tables
description: Tables over data in object storage such as Cloud Storage, read through a connection so that users need no direct access to the underlying objects.
notes: Metadata caching options (max_staleness, metadata_cache_mode) are refused; ICEBERG and DELTA_LAKE formats and s3:// / azure:// URIs are refused|managed-identity:the connection's service account is not used to authorize object reads.

name: BOOSTER_TYPE
description: Chooses the XGBoost booster type for boosted tree models, either GBTREE (the default) or DART.

name: BUDGET_HOURS
description: Sets how many hours of training an AutoML model may use; the time spent compressing the model afterwards is not counted.

name: CALCULATE_P_VALUES
description: Controls whether p-values and standard errors are computed while a linear or logistic regression model is trained.

name: capacity_commitment_option_list
description: Settings of a new capacity commitment: its plan, renewal plan, slot count and edition.

name: CATEGORY_ENCODING_METHOD
description: Chooses how non-numeric features are encoded before training, for example one-hot encoding or dummy encoding.

name: CLASS_WEIGHTS
description: Gives an explicit weight for each class label as an array of label and weight pairs; it cannot be used when AUTO_CLASS_WEIGHTS is TRUE.

name: CLEAN_SPIKES_AND_DIPS
description: Turns on or off automatic detection and cleanup of spikes and dips during ARIMA_PLUS training; detected points are replaced by interpolated values.

name: CLUSTER BY
description: Clause that sorts a table's storage by up to four columns so that queries filtering on those columns can scan less data.

name: clustering_column_list
description: Comma-separated list of up to four columns that define how a table or materialized view is clustered; columns with collation are not allowed.

name: COLSAMPLE_BYLEVEL
description: Sets the fraction of columns sampled for each new depth level of a tree in boosted tree models, drawn from the columns chosen for that tree.

name: COLSAMPLE_BYNODE
description: Sets the fraction of columns sampled each time a split is evaluated in boosted tree models, drawn from the columns chosen for the level.

name: COLSAMPLE_BYTREE
description: Sets the fraction of columns sampled once for each tree that is built in boosted tree models.

name: column
description: Defines one column of a table: its name and schema (a simple type, STRUCT or ARRAY), with optional key, default, NOT NULL and option clauses.

name: Column definitions with types, constraints (NOT NULL, DEFAULT)
description: Lists the columns of a new table, each with a data type and optional NOT NULL, DEFAULT, key and column option clauses.
notes: INTERVAL columns, nested or repeated JSON and GEOGRAPHY columns, and repeated NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC columns are refused; NOT NULL on nested STRUCT fields is refused; parameterized types inside ARRAY or STRUCT are refused.

name: column_option_list
description: Settings that can be set on a table column, such as its description, rounding mode, data policies and data governance tags.

name: column_set_options_list
description: Options that ALTER COLUMN SET OPTIONS can change on a table column, such as its description and rounding mode.

name: connection_name
description: Names a connection resource, written as project.location.connection_id or DEFAULT, that holds the credentials BigQuery uses to reach an external service.

name: connection_option_list
description: Settings for a new connection: the connection type, a friendly name and a description.

name: CONTRIBUTION_METRIC
description: Gives the expression that defines the metric to analyze in a contribution analysis model, such as a SUM or a ratio of two SUM values.

name: Create a table with a value table
description: Creating a table from a value table: it cannot be the top-level query of CREATE TABLE, but works when wrapped in a subquery or UNNEST.

name: CREATE AGGREGATE FUNCTION statement (JavaScript)
description: Creates a user-defined aggregate function written in JavaScript, with functions that initialize, aggregate, merge and finalize the result.

name: CREATE AGGREGATE FUNCTION statement (SQL)
description: Creates a user-defined aggregate function written as a SQL expression, with optional NOT AGGREGATE parameters that are not aggregated.

name: CREATE ASSIGNMENT
description: Assigns a project, folder or organization to a reservation for a given job type; assigning to none uses on-demand billing.

name: CREATE CAPACITY
description: Purchases slots by creating a capacity commitment with a chosen plan, slot count and edition.

name: CREATE CONNECTION
description: Creates a connection resource, for example a Cloud resource connection, that BigQuery uses to reach external services and data.

name: CREATE DATA_POLICY
description: Creates or replaces a data policy, either a data masking policy with a masking expression or a raw data access policy, in a project and location.

name: CREATE EXTERNAL SCHEMA
description: Creates a federated dataset, a dataset-level link between BigQuery and an external data source such as AWS Glue or Spanner.

name: CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE
description: Creates a table that lets BigQuery query data stored outside BigQuery storage, with a format, source URIs and optional schema and partition columns.

name: CREATE FUNCTION
description: Creates a user-defined function written in SQL, JavaScript or Python, or a remote function backed by an external endpoint.

name: CREATE FUNCTION IF NOT EXISTS
description: Creates a user-defined function only if no function with that name exists, and otherwise leaves the existing one in place without an error.

name: CREATE FUNCTION (JS UDF)
description: Creates a user-defined function whose body is JavaScript code given as a string, with a required return type and an optional determinism hint.
notes: edition:Full edition only (the lite edition answers 400 invalidQuery).|OPTIONS(library=...) and importedLibraries from Cloud Storage are refused (library_unavailable); NUMERIC and BIGNUMERIC inside ARRAY or STRUCT argument/return types are refused; only the description option is accepted.

name: CREATE FUNCTION (SQL UDF)
description: Creates a user-defined function whose body is a SQL expression; the return type can be inferred and parameters can use ANY TYPE.
notes: Fixed argument and return types are limited to INT64, FLOAT64, BOOL, STRING, BYTES, DATE, NUMERIC, BIGNUMERIC and ARRAY/STRUCT of them, so TIMESTAMP, DATETIME, TIME, JSON, GEOGRAPHY, INTERVAL and RANGE declarations are refused.

name: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW
description: Creates a precomputed view of a query whose results BigQuery caches and keeps current, so queries on the base tables run faster and cost less.

name: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW AS REPLICA OF
description: Creates a replica of a materialized view over an Amazon S3 BigLake table, refreshed on an interval, so the S3 data can be joined with BigQuery tables.

name: CREATE MODEL
description: Creates and trains a BigQuery ML model in a dataset from SQL, using a chosen model type, a set of options and a training query.

name: CREATE MODEL (BQML)
description: Creates and trains a BigQuery ML model from a SQL query, choosing among regression, classification, clustering, forecasting, imported and remote model types.
notes: edition:Full edition only (the lite edition answers 400 invalidQuery).|STRUCT and non-numeric ARRAY features, TRANSFORM for PCA/DNN/autoencoder/time-series/matrix-factorization/contribution models, DNN_LINEAR_COMBINED_*, and TensorFlow/AutoML model types are refused locally.

name: CREATE MODEL IF NOT EXISTS
description: Creates and trains a model only if no model with that name exists in the dataset, and otherwise does nothing.

name: CREATE MODEL statement for PCA
description: Trains a principal component analysis model that reduces the dimensionality of the input data to a chosen number of components or explained variance.

name: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION
description: Creates a user-defined function, replacing any function with the same name that already exists.

name: CREATE OR REPLACE MATERIALIZED VIEW
description: Creates a materialized view, replacing any materialized view with the same name; it cannot be combined with IF NOT EXISTS.

name: CREATE OR REPLACE MODEL
description: Creates and trains a model, replacing an existing model with the same name in the dataset.

name: CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE
description: Creates a stored procedure, replacing any procedure with the same name that already exists.

name: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE
description: Creates a table, replacing any table with the same name; it cannot turn an existing table into one with a different kind of partitioning.

name: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW
description: Creates a view, replacing any view with the same name that already exists.

name: CREATE PROCEDURE
description: Creates a stored procedure, a block of statements that other queries can call, written in GoogleSQL or as an Apache Spark procedure.

name: CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH
description: Creates a property graph over existing tables by defining node tables and optional edge tables, which can then be queried with graph query language.

name: CREATE RESERVATION
description: Creates a slot reservation with options such as slot capacity, edition, autoscaling limit, idle slot use and job concurrency.

name: CREATE ROW ACCESS POLICY
description: Creates or replaces a row-level access policy on a table that limits which rows the listed principals can read, using a filter expression.

name: CREATE SCHEMA
description: Creates a new dataset, optionally with a default collation and options such as default expiration times and an encryption key.

name: CREATE SEARCH INDEX
description: Creates a search index on one or more columns of a table so that queries using the SEARCH function can run efficiently.

name: CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE
description: Creates a read-only snapshot of a table as it was at a chosen point in time, taken from a table, a table clone or another snapshot.

name: CREATE TABLE
description: Creates a new table with columns, constraints, partitioning, clustering and options, and optionally fills it with the rows of a query.

name: CREATE TABLE AS SELECT
description: Creates a table from the result of a query, taking column names and types from the query unless a column list is given.
notes: Also INTERVAL, nested or repeated GEOGRAPHY and repeated NUMERIC/BIGNUMERIC).

name: CREATE TABLE CLONE
description: Creates a table clone, a lightweight writable copy of a table, table clone or table snapshot, optionally as of an earlier time.

name: CREATE TABLE COPY
description: Creates a table with the same metadata and data as a source table, table clone or table snapshot.

name: CREATE TABLE COPY / CLONE
description: Covers the CREATE TABLE variants that duplicate an existing table: COPY makes a full copy of schema and data, while CLONE makes a lightweight clone.

name: CREATE TABLE FUNCTION
description: Creates a table function, also called a table-valued function, that takes parameters and returns a table produced by a SQL query.

name: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS
description: Creates a table only if no table with that name exists, and otherwise leaves the existing table untouched without an error.

name: CREATE TABLE LIKE
description: Creates a table with the same metadata as an existing table but not its data unless an AS query is added; later changes to the source do not carry over.

name: CREATE TEMP FUNCTION
description: Creates a temporary user-defined function that exists only for the duration of a single query, script, session or procedure.

name: CREATE TEMP TABLE
description: Creates a temporary table that exists only within the script or session that creates it and is named without a project or dataset.

name: CREATE TEMP TABLE / CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE
description: Shows that TEMP and TEMPORARY are interchangeable keywords for creating a temporary table whose name carries no project or dataset.

name: CREATE VECTOR INDEX
description: Creates a vector index on an embedding column of a table so that vector searches run faster, trading some recall for speed.

name: CREATE VIEW
description: Creates a view, a saved query that runs when the view is queried, with optional column names and options.

name: CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS
description: Creates a view only if no view or other table resource with that name exists, and otherwise does nothing.

name: DART_NORMALIZE_TYPE
description: Chooses the normalization algorithm used with the DART booster, either TREE or FOREST, which sets how new trees are weighted against the dropped trees.

name: DATA_FREQUENCY
description: Sets the time interval of the input time series, such as hourly, daily or monthly, or lets training infer it automatically.

name: DATA_SPLIT_COL
description: Names the column used to assign rows to the training, evaluation or held-out sets when DATA_SPLIT_METHOD is CUSTOM or SEQ.

name: DATA_SPLIT_EVAL_FRACTION
description: Sets the fraction of the input data used as evaluation data when DATA_SPLIT_METHOD is RANDOM or SEQ.

name: DATA_SPLIT_METHOD
description: Chooses how input data is divided into training, evaluation and, with hyperparameter tuning, held-out sets: AUTO_SPLIT, RANDOM, CUSTOM, SEQ or NO_SPLIT.

name: DATA_SPLIT_TEST_FRACTION
description: Sets the fraction of the input data held out for scoring hyperparameter tuning trials; it applies to RANDOM or SEQ splits and goes with an evaluation fraction.

name: DECOMPOSE_TIME_SERIES
description: Controls whether the separate components of the history and forecast, such as holiday effect and seasonal components, are saved in an ARIMA_PLUS model.

name: DIMENSION_ID_COLS
description: Lists the columns, of type INT64, BOOL or STRING, that serve as dimensions when a contribution analysis model summarizes the metric.

name: DISTANCE_TYPE
description: Chooses the metric used to compute the distance between two points in a k-means model, either EUCLIDEAN or COSINE.

name: DOCUMENT_PROCESSOR
description: Identifies the Document AI processor to use when a remote model is created over the Document AI API.

name: DROP ASSIGNMENT
description: Deletes a reservation assignment, identified by its project, location, reservation and assignment IDs.

name: DROP CAPACITY
description: Deletes a capacity commitment identified by its project, location and commitment ID.

name: DROP CONNECTION
description: Deletes an existing connection resource, identified by an optional project and location plus the connection ID.

name: DROP DATA_POLICY
description: Deletes a data policy from a project, identified by its project, location and data policy name.

name: DROP EXTERNAL TABLE
description: Deletes an external table definition from BigQuery while leaving the data in the external location untouched.

name: DROP FUNCTION
description: Deletes a persistent user-defined function or user-defined aggregate function.

name: DROP FUNCTION, DROP PROCEDURE
description: Covers the statements that delete a persistent function or a stored procedure by name, each optionally guarded by IF EXISTS.

name: DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW
description: Deletes a materialized view, with IF EXISTS making a missing view a no-op rather than an error.

name: DROP pipe
description: Pipe query operator that removes the listed columns from its input table, much like EXCEPT applied to a star in standard syntax.

name: DROP PROCEDURE
description: Deletes a stored procedure identified by its optional project and dataset plus the procedure name.

name: DROP PROPERTY GRAPH
description: Deletes a property graph by name; with IF EXISTS it has no effect and raises no error when the graph does not exist.

name: DROP RESERVATION
description: Deletes a slot reservation identified by its project, location and reservation ID.

name: DROP ROW ACCESS POLICY
description: Deletes a row-level access policy from a table; removing the last policy on a table needs DROP ALL ROW ACCESS POLICIES instead.

name: DROP SCHEMA
description: Deletes a dataset; CASCADE also deletes everything in it, while RESTRICT, the default, deletes only an empty dataset.

name: DROP SEARCH INDEX
description: Deletes the search index on a table, identified by the index name and the table it belongs to.

name: DROP SNAPSHOT TABLE
description: Deletes a table snapshot, with IF EXISTS making a missing snapshot a no-op rather than an error.

name: DROP TABLE
description: Deletes a table or a table clone from a dataset, identified by its table name.

name: DROP TABLE, DROP TABLE IF EXISTS
description: Covers deleting a table, plus the IF EXISTS form that does nothing instead of failing when the table is absent.

name: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS
description: Deletes a table if it exists; when no table has that name the statement has no effect and returns no error.

name: DROP VECTOR INDEX
description: Deletes the vector index on a table, identified by the index name and the table it belongs to.

name: DROP VIEW
description: Deletes a view from a dataset, identified by its name.

name: DROP VIEW, DROP VIEW IF EXISTS
description: Covers deleting a view, plus the IF EXISTS form that does nothing instead of failing when the view is absent.

name: DROPOUT
description: Sets the dropout rate of units in a neural network model, so that some units are randomly left out during training.

name: EARLY_STOP
description: Controls whether training stops after the first iteration whose relative loss improvement falls below MIN_REL_PROGRESS.

name: ENABLE | DISABLE REFRESH
description: Switches automatic refresh of a materialized view on or off, through the enable_refresh option.

name: ENABLE_GLOBAL_EXPLAIN
description: Controls whether global explanations of feature importance are computed when the model is created, as ML.GLOBAL_EXPLAIN needs.

name: ENDPOINT
description: Names the remote endpoint that a remote model sends requests to, given as a model name or a full endpoint address.

name: ENDPOINT_IDLE_TTL
description: Sets how long an open model may sit idle before it is automatically undeployed from its serving endpoint.

name: EVALUATION_TASK
description: Sets the kind of task a model is tuned for during supervised tuning, such as text generation, classification, summarization or question answering.

name: external_schema_option_list
description: Settings for a federated dataset: its description, friendly name, location and the external source it points to.

name: external_table_option_list
description: Settings for an external table, such as its source URIs, data format, compression, field delimiter, Hive partitioning and expiration time.

name: FEEDBACK_TYPE
description: Chooses whether a matrix factorization model learns from EXPLICIT ratings or IMPLICIT feedback such as clicks, which determines the training algorithm.

name: field_name
description: Name of a field in the INPUT or OUTPUT clause of a model, which must match the endpoint request or response field names for a remote model.

name: field_type
description: Data type of a field in the INPUT or OUTPUT clause of a model, such as BOOL, INT64, FLOAT64, STRING or arrays of those for remote models.

name: FIT_INTERCEPT
description: Controls whether an intercept term is fitted to the model during training.

name: FORECAST_LIMIT_LOWER_BOUND
description: Sets a lower bound that all forecast values of a time series model must stay above; values at or below it are also excluded from modeling.

name: FORECAST_LIMIT_UPPER_BOUND
description: Sets an upper bound that all forecast values of a time series model must stay below; values at or above it are also excluded from modeling.

name: function_body
description: The definition of a user-defined aggregate function, given as a SQL expression or as a quoted JavaScript string with initialState, aggregate, merge and finalize functions.

name: function_option_list
description: Settings for a user-defined function, such as its description, libraries, remote endpoint, batching size, Python runtime version and container resources.

name: GRANT / REVOKE
description: Statements that give roles on BigQuery resources to users, groups and other principals, and take those roles away again.

name: HIDDEN_UNITS
description: Sets the hidden layers of a neural network as an array of unit counts, one entry per layer.

name: HIERARCHICAL_TIME_SERIES_COLS
description: Lists the columns that define a hierarchy, with the left-most column as the parent, so forecasts are also rolled up across the hierarchy levels.

name: Hive partitioning options
description: External table options that describe a Hive-style partitioned layout, such as the common URI prefix and whether queries must filter on partition keys.

name: HOLIDAY_REGION
description: Names one or more holiday regions whose holidays are modeled as an effect in a time series model; holiday modeling is off by default.

name: holiday_statement
description: Query that supplies custom holiday information for a time series model, with columns such as region, holiday name, primary date and the holiday effect window.

name: HORIZON
description: Sets the number of time points to forecast; when several series are forecast at once it applies to each series.

name: HPARAM_TUNING_ALGORITHM
description: Chooses the search algorithm used for hyperparameter tuning: VIZIER_DEFAULT, RANDOM_SEARCH or GRID_SEARCH.

name: HPARAM_TUNING_OBJECTIVES
description: Names the single evaluation metric that hyperparameter tuning tries to optimize, chosen from the metrics valid for the model type.

name: HUGGING_FACE_MODEL_ID
description: Identifies an open model from the Hugging Face Model Hub, in provider_name/model_name form, to deploy as a remote model.

name: HUGGING_FACE_TOKEN
description: Gives the Hugging Face user access token needed to deploy a gated or private model; the token needs read scope or broader.

name: IN, OUT, INOUT parameters
description: Parameter modes of a stored procedure: IN passes a value in, OUT returns a value to the caller, and INOUT does both.
notes: Transaction statements inside procedure bodies are refused; only strict_mode and description options are accepted.

name: INCLUDE_DRIFT
description: Controls whether an ARIMA_PLUS model includes a linear drift term; it can only be set when AUTO_ARIMA is off and the non-seasonal d is 1.

name: index_column_option_list
description: Settings for an indexed column of a search index, such as the index granularity and the data types to index.

name: index_option_list
description: Settings applied when creating an index: for a search index the analyzer and column granularity, for a vector index the index type and distance type.

name: INPUT_LABEL_COLS
description: Names the label column in the training data that holds the expected result for each row, given as a one-element array.

name: INSTANCE_WEIGHT_COL
description: Names a numeric column that gives each training row a weight; it is left out of the features and cannot be combined with class weights.

name: INTEGRATED_GRADIENTS_NUM_STEPS
description: Sets how many steps are sampled between an explained example and its baseline when approximating the integral for integrated gradients explanations.

name: IS_TEST_COL
description: Names the BOOL column that marks each input row as belonging to the group being analyzed or to the control group in a contribution analysis.

name: ITEM_COL
description: Names the column that holds the item in the training data of a matrix factorization model.

name: KMEANS_INIT_COL
description: Names the BOOL column whose TRUE rows serve as the initial centroids; it requires KMEANS_INIT_METHOD to be CUSTOM.

name: KMEANS_INIT_METHOD
description: Chooses how k-means centroids are initialized: RANDOM, KMEANS++ or CUSTOM from a BOOL column.

name: KMS_KEY_NAME
description: Names the Cloud KMS customer-managed encryption key used to encrypt the model.

name: L1_REG
description: Sets the amount of L1 regularization applied, and can take a tuning range or a list of candidates during hyperparameter tuning.

name: L1_REG_ACTIVATION
description: Sets an L1 penalty on the activations at the latent space of an autoencoder, which encourages sparse data representations.

name: L2_REG
description: Sets the amount of L2 regularization applied, and can take a tuning range or a list of candidates during hyperparameter tuning.

name: LANGUAGE js
description: Declares that the body of a user-defined function or aggregate function is written in JavaScript.
notes: edition:Full edition only (the lite edition answers 400 invalidQuery).|OPTIONS(library=...) and importedLibraries from Cloud Storage are refused (library_unavailable); NUMERIC and BIGNUMERIC inside ARRAY or STRUCT argument/return types are refused; only the description option is accepted.

name: LANGUAGE python
description: Declares that the body of a user-defined function is written in Python, run with a chosen runtime version and entry point.

name: LEARN_RATE
description: Sets the learning rate for gradient descent when LEARN_RATE_STRATEGY is CONSTANT.

name: LEARN_RATE_STRATEGY
description: Chooses how the learning rate is determined during training: LINE_SEARCH, or a CONSTANT value taken from LEARN_RATE.

name: LEARNING_RATE_MULTIPLIER
description: Scales the recommended learning rate by a positive factor when supervised tuning a remote model.

name: LS_INIT_LEARN_RATE
description: Sets the initial learning rate used by line search when LEARN_RATE_STRATEGY is LINE_SEARCH.

name: MACHINE_TYPE
description: Sets the machine type used when an open model is deployed to its serving endpoint; if omitted, the model default machine type is used.

name: materialized_view_option_list
description: Settings for a materialized view, such as whether it refreshes automatically, the refresh interval, expiration time, encryption key, description and labels.

name: materialized_view_replica_option_list
description: Settings for a materialized view replica, namely the replication interval that sets how often data is copied from the source materialized view.

name: materialized_view_set_options_list
description: Options that ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW SET OPTIONS can change, such as enabling refresh, the refresh interval, expiration time, labels and description.

name: MAX_ITERATIONS
description: Sets the maximum number of training iterations, where one iteration is a single pass over the entire training data.

name: MAX_PARALLEL_TRIALS
description: Sets how many hyperparameter tuning trials may run at the same time; NUM_TRIALS must also be set.

name: MAX_REPLICA_COUNT
description: Sets the maximum number of machine replicas used when an open model is deployed on a serving endpoint, which scales between the minimum and maximum with load.

name: MAX_TIME_SERIES_LENGTH
description: Caps the number of most recent time points of each series used to model the trend component; it cannot be combined with the length fraction option.

name: MAX_TREE_DEPTH
description: Sets the maximum depth that any single tree may reach in boosted tree models; it can also take a tuning range or candidates.

name: MIN_APRIORI_SUPPORT
description: Sets the minimum apriori_support value a segment needs to appear in contribution analysis output; it cannot be used with TOP_K_INSIGHTS_BY_APRIORI_SUPPORT.

name: MIN_REL_PROGRESS
description: Sets the minimum relative loss improvement needed to keep training when EARLY_STOP is TRUE; for example 0.01 means each iteration must cut the loss by 1 percent.

name: MIN_REPLICA_COUNT
description: Sets the minimum number of machine replicas used when an open model is deployed on a serving endpoint; the replica count never drops below it.

name: MIN_SPLIT_LOSS
description: Sets the minimum loss reduction needed to split a leaf node further in boosted tree models; larger values make training more conservative.

name: MIN_TIME_SERIES_LENGTH
description: Sets a floor on the number of time points of each series used to model the trend component; it goes with TIME_SERIES_LENGTH_FRACTION.

name: MIN_TREE_CHILD_WEIGHT
description: Sets the minimum sum of instance weight a child node needs for further partitioning in boosted tree models; larger values are more conservative.
